en.headline: Marine police officer admits assaulting domestic worker, remanded for sentencing
en.dek: A 44-year-old suspended marine officer admitted 12 charges at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts and will be sentenced on 15 December.
body: A 44-year-old marine police officer who has been suspended from duty admitted 12 charges of common assault and assault occasioning actual bodily harm at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts, local media reported.

Prosecutors withdrew charges against his wife following a plea arrangement. The magistrate imposed a three-year bind-over order on her and described the prosecution’s approach as generous. The officer was remanded in custody pending sentencing on 15 December.

Court reports indicated the couple had been accused of repeatedly assaulting their domestic worker between March and May this year at disciplined services quarters in Wong Tai Sin, with incidents captured on in-house surveillance. Police said the officer was attached to the Marine West Division.
The case remains before the court. No further details on the specific injuries or the worker’s current situation were provided in the reports.

zh.headline: 休班水警認襲擊外傭12罪 還杰候判
zh.dek: 44歲停職水警在觀塘裁判法院承認12項普通襲擊及襲擊致造成身體傷害罪，12月15日判刑。
body: 一名44歲停職水警在觀塘裁判法院承認12項普通襲擊及襲擊致造成身體傷害控罪，本地傳媒報道。
控方在認罪協議後撤回對其妻子的控罪。裁判官向妻子發出為期三年的保守行為令，並形容控方處理寬大。該水警還杰候判，判刑日期定於12月15日。
庭上報道指，夫婦兩人被指今年3月至5月期間在黃大仙紀律部隊宿舍內多次襲擊外傭，部分過程由屋內閉路電視拍攝。警方表示該名水警隸屬水警西分區。
案件仍在審理中。報道未有進一步披露具體傷勢或外傭現況。
